name: Sanmenxia

queries.query: Sanmenxia China official cadastral map parcel viewer Sanmenxia real estate registration
queries.result: First-party results identified the Sanmenxia municipal government portal and an official local real-estate registration and transaction center. The official material describes registration procedures and integrated online services, but no public parcel viewer, downloadable parcel layer, or anonymous parcel geometry API was identified.

queries.query: 三门峡 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 地图服务 官方
queries.result: 三门峡市政府 first-party results evidenced the local 不动产登记和交易中心 and municipal registration procedures, including online application and local data integration. No current public cadastral viewer or parcel feature service with safe native parcel IDs and geometry was found. The homepage map asset is an administrative city map, not a parcel layer.

registryBasis: The official Sanmenxia municipal government portal evidences the Sanmenxia Real Estate Registration and Transaction Center (三门峡市不动产登记和交易中心) and municipal registration procedures. This is local registry/procedure evidence, not evidence of an open parcel geometry service.

officialSources.publisher: 三门峡市人民政府 / Sanmenxia Municipal People's Government
officialSources.observation: Official municipal portal; its visible map asset is an administrative city map and does not expose parcel data.

officialSources.publisher: 三门峡市人民政府办公室
officialSources.observation: Official 2018 implementation notice for integrated real-estate transaction and registration services. It describes municipal/county data integration, online service goals, and the registration workflow, but provides no public parcel API or viewer URL.

officialSources.publisher: 三门峡市人民政府 / 三门峡日报
officialSources.observation: Official municipal news item directly names the local real-estate registration and transaction center and its public service role.

officialSources.publisher: 三门峡市不动产登记和交易中心
officialSources.observation: Search result identifies a center-published digital registration-service notice; direct anonymous GET returned HTTP 403 during this attempt, so no viewer JavaScript/configuration or API route could be inspected.

serviceMetadata.schemaInspection: No public parcel service endpoint was discovered; therefore no parcel schema, CRS, native identity, or bounded feature response was observed.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Local registry/procedure evidence exists, but no independently qualified real adapter or safe anonymous parcel ID plus geometry response was verified. Research completion is not source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.

pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point retained exactly in latitude/longitude order; no coordinate adjustment was made to obtain a parcel hit.
